info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides access to feedback on career applications submitted through the platform. It allows businesses to retrieve valuable insights and evaluations from applicants, which can enhance the hiring process and lead to better recruitment decisions. Typical consumers of this API include HR personnel and hiring managers who are looking to analyze feedback trends and improve candidate experiences. By utilizing this resource, organizations can gather structured feedback data to support their talent acquisition strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to access user feedback related to applications. It provides valuable insights that can help improve the application experience based on user inputs.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to submit feedback regarding the application. It should contain all necessary information to help process the user's feedback effectively.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to feedback applications.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.title: Feedback Response Schema

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the feedback operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the feedback request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the feedback operation.

state.description: The current state of the feedback operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the feedback request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: An informational message regarding the feedback operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the feedback operation.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.description: Schema representing the response for feedback operations, including status, identifiers, and audit information.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information Schema

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the person who created the feedback.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the feedback was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the feedback was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information for feedback operations.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps in assessing the performance of the API endpoint.
